definition: means the Policy Schedule attached to and forming part of this Policy specifying the details of the Insured Persons, the Sum Insured, the Policy Period and the Sub-limits to which benefits under the Policy are subject to, including any annexures and /or endorsements, made to or on it from time to time, and if more than one, then the latest in time.
plain: The document attached to your policy naming the insured persons, the sum insured, the policy period and the sub-limits your cover is actually subject to.
whyItMatters: The wording tells you what the product can do; the schedule tells you what yours does. Waiting periods, co-pays and sub-limits are stated here per policy, which is why two people holding the same product can have materially different cover. When any review — including ours — quotes a figure, your schedule is what overrides it.
